title: Border and Cover
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Freya Quintana, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
